 AFCON 2027: Sierra Leone national team intensify preps in Kinshasa for DR Congo match
 📅 November 11, 2026 
  • 
 👤 Kabuma Node 
  • 
 📁 AFCON 
  • 
 🕑 2 min read 
 The Leone Stars continued their preparations in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, ahead of Thursday’s crucial encounter against the Leopards of DR Congo in the 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕 𝐀𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐚 𝐂𝐮𝐩 𝐨𝐟 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 (𝐀𝐅𝐂𝐎𝐍) 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐫𝐬.
 The team took to the training ground as 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐂𝐨𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐃𝐢𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐃𝐚 𝐑𝐨𝐬𝐚 and his technical team continued to fine-tune preparations for the highly anticipated showdown.
 With more players having joined the camp, the squad is gradually taking shape as Sierra Leone prepares for the important challenge against the Congolese side.
